title: cedrela febrifuga var. cochinchinensis
intro: Cedrela febrifuga var. cochinchinensis, commonly known as the Cochinchinese cedar tree, is a plant species in the family Meliaceae. It is valued for its traditional medicinal uses, with reported health benefits including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and malaria, as well as its potential to reduce inflammation and alleviate pain. The therapeutic actions of Cedrela febrifuga var. cochinchinensis are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antipyretic and anti-inflammatory properties, and act as an antimalarial agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and coumarins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
